assets.title: HD Muse-inspired panda
assets.description: Refined panda and green shoulder dragon with 2K surface detail. Portraits and videos use dense combed native hair; interactive 3D uses lighter cutout fur cards. Newly authored, not the original Muse model or an exact-quality match.

assets.title: HD workshop robot
assets.description: Blue-and-cream workshop robot with high-resolution brushed surfaces, beveled shells, layered joints, circuit board and probe. Native 1600-pixel portrait and 720-pixel action previews; no animal fur.

assets.title: HD fox craftsperson
assets.description: Orange fox with a teal scarf, sketchbook and pencil. Portraits and videos use dense combed native hair; interactive 3D uses lighter cutout fur cards. Includes HD coat textures and four skeletal actions.

assets.title: HD articulated desk lamp
assets.description: Burgundy-and-brass lamp with high-resolution metal surfaces, hollow reflector, machined hinges, springs, wiring and tracing stylus. Native 1600-pixel portrait and 720-pixel action previews; no animal fur.

assets.title: Original panda reference
assets.description: The supplied portrait and four original video clips. This reference pack contains no 3D mesh or rig.
